Standard: All non-verbal aural alerts are IAW MIL-STD-1472, Characteristics of Audio Warning Signals paragraphs and MIL-STD-1472, Signal Characteristics in Relation to Operational Conditions and Objectives paragraphs. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Verify that non-verbal aural alerts are IAW MIL-STD-1472, Characteristics of Audio Warning Signals paragraphs and MIL-STD-1472, Signal Characteristics in Relation to Operational Conditions and Objectives paragraphs. Demonstration.
  (1) Conduct a demonstration to verify the effectiveness of the non-verbal aural alerts to include the perception and recognition by the crewmembers of the alerting condition during possible other concurrent audio events and correct discrimination by the crewmembers of alerting signals in representative noise conditions. The demonstration will be conducted in an environment that incorporates all normal operational stressors to which crewmembers will be exposed in the context of a representative flight profile. The demonstration should include cascading failure scenarios. This evaluation should be in a production representative mock-up. Test.
    (1) Ground or Lab test: Record the characteristics of the signals at listener ear positions in quiet conditions if possible.
    (2) Lab test: Verify the audio signal characteristics (e.g., frequency, duration, intensity) of the aural alerts are IAW MIL-STD-1472, Characteristics of Audio Warning Signals paragraphs, MIL-STD-1472, Signal Characteristics in Relation to Operational Conditions and Objectives paragraphs. Prior to entering operational test or operations, verify the standard by the following method(s): Test.
    (3) Ground test: Review ground test results to validate the results from analysis, lab testing, and demonstration.
    (4) Flight test: Review flight test results to validate the results from analysis, lab testing, and demonstration.
